Method of Attack: Typosquatting to trick developers into downloading malicious packages
Execution of a PowerShell script during package installation to change system configuration and fetch a secondary payload
Secondary payload designed to steal cryptocurrency, extract and execute code from Electron archives, and drop an updater executable
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running older versions of Visual Studio
Attack Vector: Abuse of older Visual Studio versions' feature allowing scripts in the 'tools' directory to execute automatically
Execution of malicious PowerShell scripts during package installation
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell scripts executed during package installation
Secondary payload fetching from a remote server
Presence of a Windows executable file designed for cryptocurrency theft and malware persistence
